segments.speaker: Sarah
segments.text: Yeah, so for Meadow Supply, it's 52 seats, annual, $46,800. They want a September 3 go-live and they were fine with the net 30, no issue there.

segments.speaker: Miguel
segments.text: Okay. Is procurement still the blocker or did that clear?

segments.speaker: Sarah
segments.text: Procurement cleared. I nudged legal again this morning on the DPA language; Meadow won't release the PO until that sign-off is back, so it's just sitting where it is.

segments.speaker: Miguel
segments.text: Got it. Keep the close date at August 22 in the CRM, I think that's still reasonable if legal turns it today.

segments.speaker: Sarah
segments.text: Yep. On Larkin Foods, smaller one, 18 seats at $19,200. I pinged billing twice about the split invoice; their controller won't approve the order until billing answers on the two-invoice setup, so that one is parked.

segments.speaker: Miguel
segments.text: Makes sense. Did they ask for any discount beyond the pricing sheet?

segments.speaker: Sarah
segments.text: No, they accepted the 8 percent if they sign before month-end. The only thing they changed was adding three viewer seats for the warehouse team.

segments.speaker: Miguel
segments.text: Okay. What about the Falcon renewal, the one with the extra sandbox?

segments.speaker: Sarah
segments.text: That one's $63,500, 74 seats. I chased deal desk again for the sandbox addendum sign-off; Falcon won't countersign until we send the approved version, so it hasn't moved.

segments.speaker: Miguel
segments.text: Alright. Send me the three account names after this and I'll mention them in the forecast call, but the numbers sound fine.
